title_zh: 东方意蕴，万象共生——中国当代绘画艺术展
title_en: Eastern Essence, Symbiosis of All Things: Contemporary Chinese Painting Exhibition
content_zh: 东方意蕴，万象共生——中国当代绘画艺术展
斯德哥尔摩中国文化中心，斯德哥尔摩，2026
“东方意蕴，万象共生——中国当代绘画艺术展”由斯德哥尔摩中国文化中心与李可染画院联合举办，展现三段特色鲜明的又精神贯通的中国艺术脉络：李可染先生以写生革新传统山水，后学努力开拓笔墨的表现疆域，当代艺术家融水墨、岩彩、重彩、工笔等多元语言探索传统的最新表达。上世纪50年代，李可染曾赴欧洲写生，以东方笔墨描绘西方风景；六十余年后，其艺术脉络重回欧洲，构成一场跨越时空的艺术回响。
content_en: Eastern Essence, Symbiosis of All Things: Contemporary Chinese Painting Exhibition

Held by the China Cultural Centre in Stockholm in collaboration with the Li Keran Academy of Painting, 'Eastern Essence, Symbiosis of All Things' presents three distinguished yet interconnected trajectories of Chineses art: Mr. Li Keran's reform of traditional landscape painting through life sketching, his successors' exploration into the expressive potential of brush-and-ink, and contemporary artists' diverse experiments with ink, mineral pigments, heavy colour and Gongbi techniques to reinterpret tradition in a new context. In 1950s Li Keran travelled to Europe to depict western landscapes with eastern brushwork. After 60 years, his artistic lineage visits Europe again, forming a resonant echo across time and space.
